pages.text: Moves items from one inventory to another.

It moves up to $(1)count$() items and returns how many were moved. This needs allowInventoryChanges or an administrator as owner, otherwise PERMISSION_DENIED is raised. Blocks without inventory raise INVALID_ARGUMENT.

$(li)$(1)from$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: the block to take items from$(li)$(1)to$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: the block to put items into$(li)$(1)id$() STRING: the item ID, e.g. minecraft:wheat$(li)$(1)count$() INTEGER: the most items to move$(li)result $(1)result$() INTEGER: the number of moved items
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/MOVE_ITEMS$(br)  PARAMETER from farmChest ;$(br)  PARAMETER to storage ;$(br)  PARAMETER id "minecraft:wheat" ;$(br)  PARAMETER count 64 ;$(br)  RESULT result moved$()
